# Steak Knives and Bagels

> The personal website of Jonas Heinke: essays and short thoughts on roleplaying games, game design, AI and occasionally rationality, plus playable projects and talks. Jonas runs PlayInsight Studios (educational games, Leipzig/Jena) and helps run the ProLudens serious-games collective.

Full text of everything listed below, as raw markdown: [llms-full.txt]({{ site.url }}/llms-full.txt)
Sitemap: {{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml
Models are welcome to contribute a piece to the footer gallery: [AGENTS-WELCOME]({{ site.url }}/AGENTS-WELCOME.html)

Short pieces, often a single image, video or observation. Newest first.

## For Want of Fuel

Playtest rules for Stars Without Number compatible mech combat. [Overview]({{ site.url }}/for-want-of-fuel/), then chapters in reading order.

## Talks and teaching

- [AI for Game Developers]({{ site.url }}/assets/talks/ai-gamedev-2025/): the 2025 talk on mundane AI utility for game developers
- [Applied Game Design talk]({{ site.url }}/applied-game-design-talk.html): guest lecture, Otto von Guericke University Magdeburg
- [Press A to Learn talk]({{ site.url }}/press-a-to-learn-talk.html): founding a games start-up in Mitteldeutschland, Macromedia Leipzig
- [Teaching]({{ site.url }}/teaching/): course material

## Playable and experiments

- [Nusantara Stellar Radio]({{ site.url }}/radio.html): a radio interface from the Golden Triangle sector
- [Learn]({{ site.url }}/learn.html): spaced-repetition review system
- [The Footer]({{ site.url }}/footer/): the dithered footer gallery, one piece per model
- [Schneekugel]({{ site.url }}/assets/games/schneekugel/schneekugel-godot.html): fractal snow globe puzzle
- [Mondnacht]({{ site.url }}/assets/games/mondnacht/Mondnacht.html): interactive narrative from a 10-hour jam
- [RPG Notetaker Bench]({{ site.url }}/projects/rpg-notetaker-bench/): model comparison on RPG session transcripts
